```{r}
# Function to save genes LFCs and padjs as csv tooo
save_heatmap_csv <- function(LFCs, padjs, save_file){
  
  # Rename columns 
  LFCs <- LFCs %>% rename_with(~paste0(., "_LFC")) %>% rename("Gene" = "X_LFC")
  padjs <- padjs %>% rename_with(~paste0(., "_padj")) %>% rename("Gene" = "X_padj")
  
  # Merge & save
  df_info <- merge(LFCs, padjs, by="Gene") 
  
  save_file <- gsub("\\.pdf$", ".csv", save_file)
  write.csv(df_info, save_file) 
  
}


generate_heatmap <- function(ontology, comparisons, save_file, width, height){
    
  retrieved <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype="GOALL", keys=ontology, columns="SYMBOL")
  retrieved <- retrieved %>% filter(EVIDENCEALL %in% c("IDA", "IMP", "IPI", "IGI")) # Keep experimental codes
  
  columns = c("X", "Log2FC", "padj", "Comparison")
  comparison_heatmap = data.frame(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = length(columns))) 
  colnames(comparison_heatmap) = columns
   
  i <- 1
  for (df in comparisons) {
  
    df_name <- print(names(comparisons[i]))
    df_plot <- df[df$X %in% retrieved$SYMBOL,]
      
    df <- df_plot %>%
    arrange(log2FoldChange)  %>%                       
    dplyr::select(X, padj, log2FoldChange)  %>%              # Select columns to plot
    mutate(Comparison = df_name)                             # Add column group name
    
    comparison_heatmap <- rbind(comparison_heatmap, df)
  
    i <- i+1
  }
  
  
  # Get LFC
  df_LFC <- comparison_heatmap %>%
    group_by(X) %>%
    filter(any(padj < 0.01 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5)) %>%
    dplyr::select(X, log2FoldChange, Comparison)  # Keep X, log2FC and Comparison
  
  df_LFC <- pivot_wider(df_LFC, names_from = Comparison, values_from = log2FoldChange)
  m_LFC <- data.matrix(df_LFC)
  row.names(m_LFC) <- df_LFC$X
  m_LFC <- m_LFC[, -1]
  
  # Get padj
  df_padj <- comparison_heatmap %>%
    group_by(X) %>%
    filter(any(padj < 0.01 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5)) %>%
    dplyr::select(X, padj, Comparison)  # Keep X, log2FC and Comparison
  
  df_padj <- pivot_wider(df_padj, names_from = Comparison, values_from = padj)
  m_padj <- data.matrix(df_padj)
  row.names(m_padj) <- df_padj$X
  m_padj <- m_padj[, -1]
  
  sign_labels <- m_padj
  sign_labels[sign_labels <= 0.001] <- "***" 
  sign_labels[(sign_labels > 0.001) & (sign_labels <= 0.01)] <- "**"
  sign_labels[(sign_labels > 0.01) & (sign_labels <= 0.05)] <- "*"
  sign_labels[sign_labels > 0.05] <- ""
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PLOTTING SCHEMING EVEN
  
  # NA omit
  na_rows <- complete.cases(m_LFC)
  m_LFC <- m_LFC[na_rows, ]
  sign_labels <- sign_labels[na_rows, ]
  
  rg <- max(abs(m_LFC), na.rm = TRUE) # Center 0 for legend
  color_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#0246b3", "white", "#b30904"))(100) # color
  
  genes_heatmap <- pheatmap(m_LFC,
                            main = ontology,
                            na_col = "white",
                            color = color_palette,
                            cluster_rows=F, cluster_cols = F,
                            border_color = "grey92",
                            angle_col = 45,
                            cex = 0.8,
                            show_rownames = TRUE, 
                            show_colnames = TRUE,
                            fontsize_col = 11,
                            fontsize_row = 7,
                            display_numbers = sign_labels,
                            width=8, height=10, cellwidth = 16, cellheight=5,
                            breaks = seq(-rg, rg, length.out = 100))
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save plot
  pdf(file=save_file, width=width, height=height)
  print(genes_heatmap)
  dev.off()
  
  save_heatmap_csv(df_LFC, df_padj, save_file)
  
}

```
